name: Agent Orchestrator
author: meviusisback
description: Live monitor and workspace orchestrator for AI coding agents (Herdr, OMP, Hermes, Claude, Codex, Grok) in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Real-time status, active tasks, and one-click workspace switching for AI coding agents.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How frequently the widget polls for agent status updates.

schema.label: Bar display mode
schema.description: Icon shows the orchestrator glyph + badge; Status shows the top active task; Compact shows total and busy count.

schema.label: Show count when all idle
schema.description: Whether to display the badge number in the bar when all agents are idle.

schema.label: Max task description length
schema.description: Maximum characters shown in the bar ticker for active tasks.

schema.label: Hide prompt text (screen sharing)
schema.description: Hide agent-supplied task and prompt text in the bar and cards, showing only counts, status and location — useful when recording or sharing your screen.
